Flag procedure timing relative to an index procedure

Source: R/pr-timing.R
nis_flag_pr_timing.Rd

Compares procedure slots with the correspondingly numbered PRDAY values. The earliest valid index day is used when the index procedure occurs in multiple slots. A slot matching both prefix sets counts as both procedures. Prefixes follow the normalization and matching rules of nis_flag_pr(). Negative days (including HCUP sentinel values) and missing days are unknown. If either procedure is absent, the result is FALSE. Otherwise, any outcome with a known day satisfying the relation returns TRUE. If none does and a matching procedure has an unknown day, exclude returns FALSE, assume_same_day treats that day as 0, and indeterminate returns NA.

Usage

nis_flag_pr_timing(
  .data,
  index_pr,
  outcome_pr,
  name = "outcome_post_index",
  relation = c("on_or_after", "after", "before", "same_day", "within_days"),
  window = NULL,
  missing_day = c("exclude", "assume_same_day", "indeterminate"),
  system = c("icd10", "icd9")
)

Arguments

.data

A data frame or lazy Arrow query.

index_pr

Character vector of index procedure code prefixes.

outcome_pr

Character vector of outcome procedure code prefixes.

name

Single name for the new logical flag.

relation

Timing relation: on_or_after, after, before, same_day, or within_days.

window

Required non-negative integer for within_days; otherwise NULL.

missing_day

How to handle unknown days: exclude returns FALSE, assume_same_day uses day 0, and indeterminate returns NA unless a determinate match is TRUE.

system

Code system: icd10 uses I10_PR; icd9 uses PR.

Value

.data with the logical column named by name.

Details

on_or_after tests outcome day >= earliest index day; after tests >; before tests <; same_day tests equality. within_days tests whether the outcome is from 0 through window days after the earliest index day, inclusive.

Examples

toy <- data.frame(I10_PR1 = c("02UG0JZ", "0JH604Z"), PRDAY1 = c(0L, 1L))
nis_flag_pr_timing(toy, "02UG0", "0JH60")
#>   I10_PR1 PRDAY1 outcome_post_index
#> 1 02UG0JZ      0              FALSE
#> 2 0JH604Z      1              FALSE
